The source discipline is not named in the packet, so the no_source_imagery judgment rests on the visible counterpart phrase and the 'delta' vocabulary only.

These were judged to be wording changes because the surrounding context keeps the same construction and conclusion, but a stricter reading could regard the second as a slight loosening of the comparison's scope.
